correctness.rationale: The compact positive Toeplitz operator has precisely the Gamma(k+1,1) diagonal entries (factor 1/k!). Uniform Stirling expansion yields h=g prime+(x/2)g double-prime+g triple-prime/3 with \(O(N^{-1})\) remainder on bounded normalized degrees. Chebyshev tail control bounds all maximizing degrees at \(O(\sqrt N)\). A monotone hyperbolic-sine quotient gives a unique critical separation. At supercritical maxima the strict inequality h(x*)<0 fixes the negative branch. At criticality g fourth derivative is -24 gamma and h first derivative is -8 gamma, so exact quartic maximization gives -cube_root(2) and the 6*cube_root(2)*gamma norm term. Nearest-integer lattice errors vanish. Reproducible standalone checker executed with 119 finite corroborating assertions; asymptotic validity comes from proof.

value.rationale: The exact spectral maximizing degree controls which monomial captures the strongest radial localization. At a physically natural band-coalescence threshold, the classical Gaussian profile has a flat maximum and cannot identify that degree. The sharp universal \(N^{1/3}\) displacement and positive \(N^{-2/3}\) norm correction quantify the instability; above criticality skewness breaks an otherwise exact two-peak symmetry. These are structural transitions rather than renamings, fixed-parameter numerics, or routine evaluation of an incomplete-gamma table.
